# Braintrust — LLM-Friendly Site Summary
# https://usebraintrust.com/llms.txt
# Standard: https://llmstxt.org/
# Updated: 2026-05-19

> Braintrust is an AI infrastructure company building three enterprise products: Braintrust AIR (conversational AI interview software), the Talent Marketplace (vetted professional network, 2M+ members), and Braintrust Nexus (enterprise workflow automation). Founded 2018, San Francisco. SOC 2 Type II certified. 100+ enterprise customers.

## Products

- [Braintrust AIR](https://usebraintrust.com/products/air): AI interview software that conducts conversational voice interviews, scores resumes semantically, assesses candidates through domain-specific evaluations, and ranks applicants. Supports 16+ languages. Passed independent third-party bias audit with zero adverse findings across all demographic groups. Integrates with Workday, iCIMS, Greenhouse, SmartRecruiters. SSO, SOC 2 Type II.
- [Try AIR](https://usebraintrust.com/products/air/try): Live interactive AIR demo — experience an AI interview firsthand.
- [AIR Compliance](https://usebraintrust.com/products/air/compliance): Bias audit documentation, EEOC compliance, and regulatory framework for AI-assisted hiring.
- [AIR Release Notes](https://usebraintrust.com/air-release-notes): Weekly changelog of new features, improvements, and fixes shipped to the AIR platform (42+ weeks of history from May 2025).
- [AI Hiring Compliance](https://usebraintrust.com/how-braintrust-air-stays-compliant): How Braintrust AIR stays compliant with U.S., Canada, and EU AI hiring regulations including NYC Local Law 144, EEOC, Illinois AEIA, GDPR, and EU AI Act.
- [Talent Marketplace](https://usebraintrust.com/products/talent-marketplace): Network of 2M+ vetted professionals in engineering, ML, data science, design, and finance. AI-powered matching delivers candidates in hours. Zero agency markup.
- [Braintrust Nexus](https://usebraintrust.com/products/nexus): Enterprise workflow automation. Builds and deploys custom automation across any enterprise systems via API. Shared-savings pricing: companies keep 75%, Braintrust takes 25%.
- [AI Training Data](https://usebraintrust.com/solutions/ai-training-data): Human data infrastructure for AI labs — RLHF specialists, data labelers, annotators, expert evaluators, red teamers. 100+ countries, 50+ languages.
- [Pricing](https://usebraintrust.com/pricing): Pricing for AIR, Marketplace, and Nexus.
- [Book a Demo](https://usebraintrust.com/book-demo): Schedule a product demonstration with the Braintrust team.

## For Talent

- [For Talent](https://usebraintrust.com/for-talent): How professionals join, get vetted, and find enterprise contract work through Braintrust.
- [Browse Jobs](https://usebraintrust.com/jobs): Open contract roles — engineering, AI/ML, data science, design, and more.
- [AI Training Gig Work](https://usebraintrust.com/ai-training): Earn $20–$200/hr training AI models in your field of expertise. Flexible schedule. No AI background required.
- [Talent Certification](https://usebraintrust.com/talent-certification): Braintrust skills certification and vetting process.

## Company

- [About](https://usebraintrust.com/about): Company history (founded 2018), executive team, and investor roster (Coatue, Tiger Global, Pantera Capital, IDEO, Omidyar Network, and others).
- [Blog](https://usebraintrust.com/blog): AI recruiting, talent operations, and workforce automation content.
- [Resources](https://usebraintrust.com/resources): Guides and research on AI interview software.
- [Press](https://usebraintrust.com/press): 60+ press mentions from Forbes, Bloomberg, Fortune, Reuters, WSJ, Harvard Business Review, Fast Company, Business Insider, and more.
- [Client Stories](https://usebraintrust.com/clients): Case studies from enterprise clients including Nestlé, Pacific Life, Deloitte, and others.

## Token

- [BTRST Token](https://usebraintrust.com/token): Braintrust network governance and utility token — rewards, ecosystem participation.

## Referral Programs

- [Refer AIR](https://usebraintrust.com/refer/air): Earn rewards — $5 for a LinkedIn post, $25 for a G2 review, $1,000 for a converted customer referral.
- [Refer Marketplace](https://usebraintrust.com/refer/marketplace): Talent referral program.
